study_name: S2 r4与r5同截点独立分析政策包流程试验
source_binding_rule: The prepared JSON is a preparation specification. freeze captures the actual full original bytes of both packages, records real time and external manifest SHA; final source tree must be independently authenticated before any real request.

left.name: 上传全文v1.7修订批次4＋图规v1.2修订批次4

right.name: 当前全文v1.7修订批次5＋图规v1.2修订批次5＋本次已验收报告输出与开测工程

intervention.causal_claim_limit: Compare the complete declared packages. Differences inside a package are not separate causal factors; a single-rule ablation needs another prospectively frozen study. Neutral factual collection, quote interpretation and scoring are held common.
intervention.production_behavior: left and right are experimental runs; existing production four-state analysis is unchanged by registration

target_task: 从共同完整三市场证据与报价池选择一张常规时间相对主票，保留最强备选、反证、条件，并独立给单关适配；未评估的串关腿保持未知

scope.description: activation以后本用户在本项目首次请求的真实赛前单场分析，限这18赛事；条件是请求而不是推荐或赛果成功
scope.sampling_rule: record every intake before filtering; first pre-kickoff request per competition+match_id is primary. Unsupported, missing image/model, abstention, failure, unresolved condition, late registration and abandoned runs remain in the universe. Later versions are append-only updates and not new matches.
scope.inference_limit: user-requested matches are a selected population, not all fixtures or all football bettors

neutral_pool.source: a genuine prospective F2 evidence-only bundle with no main ticket, no candidates, no earlier analysis and no outcome
requirements: match identity and actual current kickoff
all actual original screenshots and whole market rows; snapshot_latest/as_of_latest separated
same fixed production source/state hashes, full score matrix axes/tail normalization and actual integration match replay
same up-to-cutoff football facts; missing freshness reasons remain
unverified API Asian handicap excluded from settleable pool
one shared manifest and complete model/forecast parent lineage
neutral_pool.quote_control: The policy comparison uses the same independently verified neutral quote rows. If a run changes interpretation or omits a row, record a pool violation instead of silently repairing its output. OCR extraction quality is a separate blinded benchmark.
neutral_pool.score_model_rule: same actual complete regulation score matrix is supplied to both sides; no personnel/xG/manual lambda adjustment, no refitting, no F5 candidate substitution

independent_execution.context: fresh isolated context for each side; no conversation history, sibling outputs, result/gold OCR truth or previous recommendations
independent_execution.fixed_engine: same actually available GPT model/version and declared execution parameters; record unavailable properties as unknown. Changed engine or prompts starts a new version or is non-comparable
independent_execution.failure: write the actual failure or partial slot immediately; retries append and never replace the first output
independent_execution.abstention: explicit no_qualifying_contract or purpose_mismatch only; missing, conditional, failure and unknown are not zero-return abstentions
independent_execution.independence_limit: different ids, hashes or fresh sessions alone cannot prove unexposed independent cognition; retain producer/session/input exposure records
independent_execution.adapter: preserve full raw original output; translate only explicitly present fields. r4 absent grades/times/probabilities remain null, not inferentially filled

shadow_grades.single_usage: A/B/C/D/U and reasons recorded for selected contract, separately from formal four-state action and price value
shadow_grades.parlay_leg_usage: evaluate contract fit and fragile branches as an individual possible leg; no automatic one-grade downgrade, no whole-parlay return or suitability inferred

grade_meaning.A: 完整支持、支付边界、最强反证/替代、普通分支稳定性及脆弱假设；定性候选不等于固定命中率或正EV
grade_meaning.B: 决定链完整，仍有明确弱点；不借等级省略条件
grade_meaning.C: 观察，明确区分证据链未完成与不符合当前用途；待条件须另记awaiting_condition且当前等级为空
grade_meaning.D: 依据支持不建议，不与未选为主票混同
grade_meaning.U: 无法判断/必要证据不足，缺失不填0

shadow_grades.evaluation: coverage, admission/wait/abstain, calibration and realized contract returns by declared objective; value-focused A need not beat low-price B raw hit rate

metrics.primary: 流程试运行：完整请求中真正独立首输出、共同池/模型/时间绑定、正确合约结算和全过程保存率；失败按真实类型披露
metrics.guardrail: No overwritten originals, hindsight qualification, invented unknown fields, non-neutral pool, sign/time mistakes or undeclared engine/rule drift. Any such error blocks the affected opportunity and is appended for repair.
metrics.policy_effect: QUOTE_REF unit return difference right-left per opportunity, at a declared fee-free paper contract; explicit true abstention zero exposure, missing/failed/unresolved not zero. This is a gross reference simulation, not tradable ROI or real profit. Cost_per_unit=0 is a definition of this paper estimand, not a claim that real costs are zero.
secondary: per-bet reference ROI with its own stake denominator
selected-contract full/half win/push/loss, P(R>0) vs P(R>=0) vs EV separately if actually computed
same full-match 1X2 Brier/log loss only as a shared-model consistency check, usually equal; five-state losses of different contracts are not comparable accuracy spaces
metrics.interval: existing decision_trials within-match averaging and competition+match_id clustered bootstrap 2000 seed 20261007, descriptive only. Time/teams/season dependence is unresolved; no confirmatory promotion from these intervals.
metrics.reporting: single is main target. Parlay-leg grades are secondary descriptive; no whole-parlay outcomes. QUOTE_OPEN/ACTUAL require separate original evidence and protocol, not this controlled reference trial.

stopping.rule: The first 30 unique intake opportunities after a separately registered future start, or 90 calendar days after that start, whichever first. Include first failures, unavailable pairs and abstentions; never replace them until 30 successful pairs. Only operational counts/time choose closure.
stopping.review: Validity can be monitored continuously; close once at the frozen count/calendar node, then 14 days result grace for already-enrolled requests. All policy return/accuracy/grade effects are descriptive.
stopping.claim_limit: 30 only diagnoses flow and implementation; no model accuracy, profitability or grade effectiveness claim. A confirmatory policy study needs a new protocol, candidate-specific power/dependence plan, future activation and new cohort before any confirmatory observation.

ocr_benchmark.training_test_split: split by unique competition+match_id and exact image SHA before readings; multiple crops/versions of one match stay together; 40 historical development matches and six regression cases never enter clean acceptance
ocr_benchmark.gold: independent human-checked complete market row/state/time/line/sign/odds format/company truth, with disagreements adjudicated and raw evidence preserved
ocr_benchmark.isolation: gold files and result files are absent from reader context; the benchmark reads real original images, not reference transcript
ocr_benchmark.primary: exact complete-row correctness; also line/sign/state/top-latest/time/format field errors; all failures and unreadable rows reported
ocr_benchmark.comparison: both read the same held-out original image under frozen r4/r5 rules; no majority vote or repeated agreement treated as truth
ocr_benchmark.eligibility: synthetic engineering tests and second visual reread are separately labelled and do not count as measured OCR accuracy
ocr_benchmark.effect_claim: sample size and held-out scope must be frozen in a new separate OCR protocol before claiming improvement

activation_rules.start: future exact start_at; durable registration before every real analysis_cutoff, no retrospective registration
activation_rules.current: no genuine next-match request/neutral pool/independent output exists this turn; preparation only
